title: Barbecue Haloumi and Chips
subtitle: with Crunchy Seeds and Salad
description: Keep the kids happy – and the adults too! Simply choose our 'kid-approved' recipes filled with crowd-pleasing flavours and ingredients, then watch the whole family tuck in. You can thank us later!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into 1.5cm-thick chips. Shred the carrot with a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Drain the haloumi and dry on paper towel, then cut in half horizontally.

Roast chips: Put the potato on the lined tray. Drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil, scatter over half the barbecue seasoning, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast the potato, turning halfway, for 20 mins or until golden. Scatter over the sunflower seeds and roast for a further 5 mins or until the seeds are golden and the potato is tender.

Pan-fry haloumi: Meanwhile, put the remaining barbecue seasoning and 2 tsp olive oil in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Add the haloumi and turn to coat. Heat a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove the pan from the heat.
Make salad: Combine 2 tsp olive oil, 2 tsp red wine vinegar and 1 tsp sugar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the carrot and salad leaves and toss to combine (see Make it yours).
Serve up: Divide the haloumi, chips and sunflower seeds and salad among plates. Serve with the mayonnaise for dipping and enjoy!
Make it yours: Feel free to toss in other salad goodies from your veggie drawer, such as cucumber, tomato, capsicum or avocado.
